reuse.why: Adds one selection function used by every month-wide action and routes the averages through the existing setNMonthAvg, but detects saved templates by matching goal_def strings in SQL rather than by the JSON parsing the goal-template code uses.

duplication.why: Removes the three copies of the category query and the inline sign flip in set3MonthAvg; what remains is the income-outside-tracking guard repeated in each action and copyPreviousMonth keeping its own hidden/group_hidden check on top of the shared set.

placement.why: The selection lives in server/budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it and the helpers they already share.

scope.why: Besides the selection, it folds set3/6/12MonthAvg into a new setBulkAvg and switches the per-category writes from fire-and-forget to awaited, a refactor the request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: The eligibility rule now has one home and the averages one implementation; the string-literal check for an empty template list and the leftover hidden test in copyPreviousMonth are the weak spots.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) select categories through getFillableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repeat, copyPreviousMonth's hidden/group_hidden check alongside the fillable set, is left visibly as it was.

one_place.where: getFillableCategories in server/budget/actions.ts defines hidden, hidden-group and saved-template exclusion and every month-wide action uses it; copyPreviousMonth additionally keeps its old hidden check, which is redundant rather than a second version of the rule.
